scout.resource_note: Read-only source/repository work, primary-source browser research (including non-live public Vast search-index snapshots), and one small seeded library draw; no GPU, training, benchmark, external credential CLI, provider API request, rental, or credit spend.

sources.supports: H230-shaped RTX 3060 profile: batch16, fp16, 20,000-row sequences and 2,000-row chunks; phase medians show loader wait 418.46 ms, backward 404.99 ms, optimizer 2.43 ms, observed VRAM 2.226 GB.
sources.limits: One local device; host and GPU intervals overlap; resource-only, not a score or public forecast.

sources.supports: Compact GRU B16->B32 throughput +1.94%; one loader worker +4.42%; two-worker 5GB scoped OOM; cloud duplicate hashing consumed 748.68 seconds.
sources.limits: Smaller model/targets than H230. The OOM is execution evidence for that worker profile, not a scientific result.

sources.supports: SequenceFile.read loads a full 20,000-row row group and 112 feature columns, stacks float32 columns, transposes and materializes a contiguous array; Sequences.__getitem__ invokes this path per item, with teacher arrays separately memory-mapped. The float32 feature payload is 8,960,000 bytes per sequence. The optional CudaPrefetcher queues pinned-tensor H2D on a side stream, but still obtains the next CPU batch via next(loader); zero DataLoader workers therefore leave row-group decode/collation synchronous on the iterator path.
sources.limits: Code path inspection only; no repeated-epoch decode timing, memory peak, cache break-even, or pinned-prefetch comparison was measured.

sources.kind: internal CLI help and source inspection
sources.supports: Existing durable helpers cover local attempt launch/status/reconcile/drain/resume, frozen finite distinct-ID job sequences, sealed Kaggle execution and resource heartbeats. Existing 60-second timer is for the Kaggle read-only quota/session poller.
sources.limits: CLI capability/source inspection only; this scout did not inspect host timer activity, launch attempts, change the queue, or build a Vast callback/API listener. The Kaggle poller is not a Vast process and needs an explicit stop/continuation decision when no active targets remain.

sources.supports: An own raw GRU384x2 seed3 completed four epochs in 5178.922 seconds and prediction export in 80.652 seconds; full-shape B16 profile used 2.6225 GB VRAM and 4.3004 GB scoped RAM. This is an already-existing wider endpoint candidate to grade before buying duplicate width compute.
sources.limits: AMP skipped 15 of 29,840 attempted updates; fixed ep3 export and exposed fold0 remain pending matched-control grading. Not a public score or proof of teacher/student complementarity.

sources.kind: internal actual Kaggle T4 profile and admission result
sources.supports: Actual Kaggle session listed two Tesla T4 devices with 15,360 MiB each. A different raw GRU128 recipe (260,000 parameters) completed a profile-only gate: step_wall 1067.84 ms, CUDA event stages 229.03 ms, loader_wait 1251.06 ms, and 14.98 sequences/s; pair fit/export projection exceeded its frozen cap and fit correctly did not start.
sources.limits: One warmup and three timed outer batches, loader wait exceeds wall and intervals may overlap/timer boundaries differ. It is not an H230 GRU256 matched profile, robust 20-step device ranking, two-GPU experiment, training result, or score.

sources.supports: H214 input projection hoisting, H215 independent model per chip, H216 parallel recurrence; real-device full-objective parity and warmed throughput are still needed.
sources.limits: Synthetic diagnostic is not a scientific TPU fit.

sources.limits: Installed cuDNN version and actual kernel dispatch decide applicability; a documented condition is not proof PyTorch chose or failed a Tensor Core path.

sources.kind: official framework API and training guide
sources.supports: Activation checkpointing recomputes a forward segment during backward; non-reentrant mode supports torch.autograd.grad and detached tensors in the region; RNG stashing/replay can add overhead, and context_fn controls original/recomputed execution contexts.
sources.limits: No memory, throughput, gradient-parity, or quality result has been measured for this trainer. The exact chunk/carry/autocast boundary requires an isolated parity probe.

random_library_draw.procedure: Python random.Random(seed).choice(sorted(unique nonempty lines)); no topic-conditioned filtering
random_library_draw.title: Introduction to Random Matrices: Theory and Practice
random_library_draw.excerpt: the normalized histogram of the N eigenvalues of a single (very big!) instance of the Gaussian ensemble
random_library_draw.transfer: Use a measured singular-spectrum elbow as a screen for whether an owned trained matrix merits one low-rank factorization profile. This is speculative; do not apply the Gaussian-ensemble law as a prior over trained network weights.
random_library_draw.falsifier: No stable low-rank elbow across own seeds/checkpoints, or factorization fails to improve measured step time at an acceptable fixed endpoint.
random_library_draw.limits: The sampled passage describes a Gaussian-ensemble eigenvalue density, not deep-learning optimization or this competition.
